description: Trading and personal finance toolkit for Thai investors — watchlists, signals, paper trading, trade journal, position sizing, dividends, budgets and scam checks, plus Thai money skills: investment tax, year-end deduction planning (/tax-plan), mutual funds, retirement, debt payoff and คลินิกแก้หนี้, insurance review and emergency funds, credit bureau reports, bonds and deposits, rebalancing and DCA, and home refinance. Uses whatever market-data plugins you already have.

agents.name: alert-dispatcher
agents.description: Use when the user wants price or news alerts on watched symbols. Sets scheduled checks and keeps alerts few.

agents.name: market-analyst
agents.description: Use when asking about a stock, market trend or watchlist before trading. Explains price and news plainly; not advice.

agents.name: money-planner
agents.description: Use for personal money — budget, debt, emergency fund, retirement, insurance, funds, personal tax, scam checks.

agents.name: risk-manager
agents.description: Use before opening a position, asking how much to buy, or when a portfolio drifts. Never sizes without a stop-loss.

agents.name: trade-journal-coach
agents.description: Use when reviewing past trades or a trade journal, or asking why you keep losing the same way. Finds one rule to test.

sub: **Check external tools before handing out the first piece.** For any piece that needs an MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool, load that tool by name with ToolSearch and call it once to test now (before the user leaves). Cannot call it → mark that piece `ติด` at once, with the fix written step by step (which server to connect · how to log in), then carry on with other pieces. Do not call the API directly with curl or a token in a command instead, because that goes beyond the permission the user gave.

steps.text: Do one piece at a time. Pass the section 4 criteria, then go to the next piece. Breaks twice → split into sub-steps, do not retry the same way · after 3 rounds → record it as `ติด` and go to other pieces · ใคร: workers per the `ลูกทีมต่อชิ้น` line above, a fresh one per piece · check (ตรวจ): per the `ผู้ตรวจต่อชิ้น` line above

**All other pieces are done.** Have a fresh agent on a larger model try once more from that note (an answer in the inbox → start from the answer).
**Still stuck.** Keep it in the report with what is needed from the user · the user answers later → a new session reads `CONTEXT.md` and continues from that piece.

**Stuck because it must be the user** (a decision · a check by eye or ear · spending money or tokens · endorsing text an agent wrote on their behalf): add a row to the "รอผู้ใช้" (waiting on the user) table of `CONTEXT.md` and go on to other pieces, without stopping to wait.

steps.text: When the job is finished, check all the step 1 conditions once more, run the learning round, then report once: what is done · what is stuck · how many decisions made on your own · what awaits approval · what is pending · ใคร: หัวหน้าทีม (re-checking the conditions: `reviewer` ตัวใหม่)
sub: End the report with a table `ขั้น | ผล | หลักฐาน` (step | result | evidence), 1 row per condition in step 1 · evidence is a file path · link · check result · summarise as **"ผ่าน X / N"** (passed X of N) counted from the real checker, not from what workers say · an item that needs a human eye does not count as passed, put it in a separate row `ต้องให้คนดู` (needs a person to look) · for items that failed, give the cause in 1 line.

who.raw: หัวหน้าทีม (re-checking the conditions: `reviewer` ตัวใหม่)
